_doc: Actions as chains of (action -> result on screen). Fields: events = game-log event types (any order, all expected); card = text on the card/panel that opens (substring), null = stays in gameplay; bubble = the clicked object's bubble after: gone | plant (seedling) | drop (needs water/wilted) | no-drop (crop icon without drop) | same; text = short-lived on-screen message (substring), null = none. "?" = a gap: not known yet, filled from observations (chains.gaps(apply=True) after 2 agreeing ones). source = where the expectation comes from. Code: game/chains.py; docs: docs/mechanics/interaction-laws.md.

replant.step: click the drop bubble of a wilted bed
Space on the wilted card (it has a ⃠ icon, no Remove text) -> confirmation -> press Remove
pick the crop card, press Select
click the drop bubble of the new seedling

water.step: click the drop bubble of a dry bed
click the drop bubble with an empty can

harvest.step: click the pickup bubble of a ripe bed

bed.step: click the bubble of a growing, watered bed
